FUNCTION FindSecondLargest(arr):
    IF LENGTH OF arr < 2 THEN RETURN NULL
    
    largest <- -INFINITY
    second_largest <- -INFINITY
    
    FOR EACH num IN arr DO
        IF num > largest THEN
            second_largest <- largest
            largest <- num
        ELSE IF num > second_largest AND num != largest THEN
            second_largest <- num
        END IF
    END FOR
    
    RETURN second_largest
END FUNCTION
